title: Calyx
subtitle: Site-specific public sculpture · Rochester, New York
coverAlt: Calyx public sculpture at the University of Rochester
summary: Calyx is a site-specific sculpture commissioned by the University of Rochester to celebrate a new age in which technology, art, nature, and knowledge become intertwined.
body: The sculpture’s dynamic form and patterning are influenced by leaf-venation systems found in nature, which produce structural networks and organic forms.
Its canopy acts as a recognizable campus landmark while creating a gathering place for students and visitors.
facts: Courtesy of J. Adam Fenster, University of Rochester
